enhancements.legend: An ancient hunting horn with a built-in vox amplification unit, this relic’s stirring howl can be heard even through the wild clangour of battle.
enhancements.description: Wolf priest model only. At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Hero of the Chapter
enhancements.legend: A storied and inspirational exemplar of their Chapter’s virtues, this war leader is an inspirational presence amongst the ranks of their battle-brothers.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, the bearer has the Battleline keyword.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the Vanguard
enhancements.legend: Long experience leading Phobos-armoured vanguard strikes has taught this warrior many lessons about swift and stealthy attacks.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Avenging Avatar (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Eyes alight with determination and vengeful fury, this champion of the Chapter seems almost to cast the dread shadow of the Primarch himself across his quailing foes.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 9" of the bearer, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Portents of Wisdom
enhancements.legend: This warrior has been made privy to omens of great threats in the wars to come. Armed with this knowledge, they and their battle-brothers enter battle with a boldness that some mistake for recklessness.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Castellum Omnivox
enhancements.legend: This unique vox-and-augur augmetic provides the bearer with unparalleled tactical data vital to coordinating an aggressive defence in battle.
enhancements.description:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Fall Back move, select one of the following to apply to that unit until the end of the turn:
  • That unit is eligible to perform an Action in a turn in which it Fell Back.
  • That unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Tip of the Spear
enhancements.legend: This aggressive front-line commander knows the value of speed and decisive manoeuvre.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Transport, that TRANSPORT has the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Gunnery Honours
enhancements.legend: The crew of this war machine demonstrate exemplary gunnery and have earned the highest honours for their craft.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model only. Once per phase, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll for the bearer.

enhancements.name: Troubling Visions
enhancements.legend: In the long run, these strange and intrusive visions of bloodshed bode terribly ill for this champion of the Blood Angels. In this instance, though, they bring him closer than ever to the glory of his gene-sire.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. When it does, until the start of your next Command phase, all Angelic Legacy abilities are active for the bearer’s unit, instead of only two of them.

enhancements.name: The Honour Vehement
enhancements.legend: This stanza is inscribed on thrice-blessed parchment and affixed to its bearers’ wargear with a purity seal, there to inspire them to heroic acts of martial prowess.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearers melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Stubborn Tenacity
enhancements.legend: Even for a Chapter as famously stubborn as the Dark Angels, this warrior is known for their intractable nature.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Battle-shocked and below its Starting Strength.

enhancements.name: Tolorek Data Djinn
enhancements.legend: Gifted by the Tech-Priests of Tolorek for the cleansing of Ultramar, this powerful cyberspirit uses brute force technoscreed when entreated to overwhelm the systems of enemy ships, conquering them and yoking their protocols to the bearer's will.
enhancements.description: In your Command phase, select one objective marker that you control and is within range of the bearer. Roll one D6: on a 2+, that objective marker is Secured by your army.

enhancements.name: Mounted Strategist
enhancements.legend: This warrior has mastered the art of such advanced ploys as feigning flight only to turn swiftly upon overextended foes and launch a devastating counter-offensive to shatter their lines.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Rage-fuelled Warrior
enhancements.legend: Fury burns in this warrior's soul. A single moment of savage brutality stands between them and the maddening embrace of the Black Rage.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearers melee weapons have the [sustained hits 3] ability.

enhancements.name: Osseus Key
enhancements.legend: The ancient clavis known as the Osseus Key is said to be the most powerful of its kind. Where other such devices are made from sanctified platinum, the Osseus Key is made from the hand and finger bones of deceased Imperial Fists heroes that fought in the Horus Heresy, scrimshawed with inhuman care and imbued with the fiercest machine spirits of the age. No portal can bar its bearer from entry, and no xenos machine can stand before his wrath.
enhancements.description: Watch Master or Techmarine model only. At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll; if that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

enhancements.name: Fenrisian Grit
enhancements.legend: All Fenrisians possess a formidable constitution, yet this warrior demonstrates legendary resolve, shrugging off wounds that would fell lesser men.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: Skjald
enhancements.legend: This warrior is well-versed in the Chapters saga, drawing inspiration and invaluable teachings from their retelling.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time a Space Wolves Character unit from your army achieves a Boast, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Guile
enhancements.legend: This warrior embodies the cunning of the wolf, utilising deception and misdirection to confound his foes.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Thunderwolf Cavalry, Wulfen and/or Blood Claws units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Resolute
enhancements.legend: Allowing nothing to bar his path, this champion of the Chapter ploughs a bloody path through the foe.
enhancements.description: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. In addition, Desperate Escape tests taken for the bearer are automatically passed, and each time the bearer makes a Fall Back move, it can move through enemy models as if they were not there.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Unseen
enhancements.legend: It is said that no secret can escape the gaze of this ocular augmetic, which belonged first to the feared Interrogator-Chaplain Enoch.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker: on a 5+, you gain 1CP

enhancements.name: Foes’ Fate
enhancements.legend: The skjalds tell in hushed voices how this warrior was born beneath a blood-omen moon, how his fate is interwoven with those of his prey-to-be and how he waits now at the end of each such enemy’s thread, the final and inescapable executor of their deaths.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit Falls Back, all models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.

enhancements.name: Visage of Death
enhancements.legend: This exquisitely crafted death mask is a thing of dark beauty to the Blood Angels, and a sign of impending doom to their enemies. A neural amplifier embedded within the expressionless face of this macabre item serves to magnify the aura of fear it projects.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponents Command phase, each enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: War-tempered Artifice
enhancements.legend: Having laboured long in the Chapter’s forges, this warrior-smith has crafted his personal armaments. Each weapon is a masterwork tool of death-dealing, wrought with care and strength, and embellished with the icons of their maker’s brotherhood.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Sacred Rage
enhancements.legend: So all-consuming is this warrior’s hatred of the foe, so infectious his rage at their continued existence, that it grips those who fight alongside him and goads them to smite their enemies all the more swiftly.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Consecrating Aura
enhancements.legend: The piety and honour of this warrior can be felt wherever he fights. His presence rouses the ardent souls of the Black Templars, warding Sigismund’s heirs from the blasphemy of the unbeliever.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Hunt
enhancements.legend: This veteran of the Ravenwing has spent mortal lifetimes in the saddle, leading mechanised cavalry to battle on countless worlds.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can re-roll Desperate Escape tests taken for models in the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Celerity
enhancements.legend: The powers of the Immaterium flow through the psyker, heightening his speed and that of his battle-brothers.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Psyker model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced, and if the Biomancy Discipline is active for your army, it is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Ancient Weapons
enhancements.legend: The vaults of the Dark Angels contain many relics from Humanity’s distant past. This soldier has been granted the honour of bearing such a weapon to battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

enhancements.name: Fear Made Manifest (Aura)
enhancements.legend: This warrior personifies the Emperor’s wrath.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by its controlling player). Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

enhancements.name: Ghostweave Cloak
enhancements.legend: Hand-stitched by blinded servitors and anointed with distilled blood, this cloak contains strands of mnemothread. It throws up a field of techno-spiritual dissonance that veils its wearer from sight and sensors, allowing them to slip across the battlefield like a wraith.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

enhancements.name: Blood Shard
enhancements.legend: Spiritual energy flows from this crimson gem, filling its bearer with a ferocious desire to tear their foes limb from limb. Those infused with its energies may fight on despite suffering seemingly mortal wounds.
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: The Flesh is Weak
enhancements.legend: The injuries of past battles have seen this warrior heavily rebuilt with ultra-durable cybernetic limbs and organs that render them extremely difficult to kill.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: War-tempered Artifice
enhancements.legend: Having laboured long in the Chapter’s forges, this warrior smith has crafted his personal armaments. Each weapon is a masterwork tool of death-dealing, wrought with care and strength, and embellished with the icons of their maker’s brotherhood.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Battle-psalm Precentor
enhancements.legend: The chanted oratory of this commander rises in volume and stentorian vehemence as he leads his brothers into the charge until he seems like a wrathful war deity closing with his ungodly prey.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer’s unit declares a charge, if an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test as a result of the Shock and Awe Detachment rule, subtract 1 from that Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Oathbound Exemplar
enhancements.legend: With a ceaseless and booming oratory, this commander exhorts his warriors in their duty to the Emperor. Honour, he declaims, must be pursued relentlessly.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 1 to Advance rolls made for the bearer’s unit. If the mission pack you are playing features Actions, the bearer’s unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Void Warrior
enhancements.legend: Having mastered the arts of shipboard warfare over many battles, this warrior moves swiftly through them and strikes with unerring skill.
enhancements.description: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer. In addition, the bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Clavitine Reliquary
enhancements.legend: A timeless and unique example of Chapter artifice, this device rapidly synchronises with the data spirits of locking devices and renders them quiescent.
enhancements.description: In your Movement phase, each time the bearer is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, if it is within 1" of a Hatchway, it can attempt to operate that Hatchway. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.

enhancements.name: Disciple of Rhetoricus
enhancements.legend: This battle-brother is well versed in the Book of the Five Spheres, drawing upon the teachings of that ancient treatise to command with clarity and purpose.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

enhancements.name: Coronal Susurrant
enhancements.legend: This wreath of circuitry from the Dark Age of Technology forces a whispering white noise into enemy minds and broadcasts.
enhancements.description:
Phobos model only. The bearer has the following ability:

Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Fleet Commander
enhancements.legend: The Chapter’s orbiting warships stand ready to unleash devastation at this leader’s command.
enhancements.description: CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one point on the battlefield and place a marker on that point. At the start of your next Shooting phase, place another marker on the battlefield within 12" of the centre of the first marker, then draw a straight line between the centre of each of these markers. Roll one D6 for each unit that line passes over or through: on a 3+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Both markers are then removed.

enhancements.name: Medusan Roar (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Mounted in the warrior’s gorget, this device amplifies their battle cries into terrifying sonic shock waves.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by its controlling player). Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

enhancements.name: Stormseers’ Wisdom
enhancements.legend: The Chapter’s Librarians have made this champion privy to omens of great threats in future wars. Armed with this knowledge, they lead their warriors to war with a boldness that some mistake for recklessness.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Oath of Macragge
enhancements.legend: Amongst the most solemn and binding oaths an Ultramarine can swear, it is a rare honour to enter battle with these words affixed to their armour.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Master of the Red Thirst
enhancements.legend: Long practice has allowed this champion to gain a modicum of focus and control over their Red Thirst – wisdom they pass on in the heat of battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Master of Manoeuvre
enhancements.legend: Daring and audacious, this commander favours breakneck outflanking manoeuvres that allow them to plunge into the enemy's midst from unexpected quarters.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing model only. If the bearer’s unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, its points value does not count towards the combined points limit for units from your army that are in Strategic Reserve, and for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Codex
enhancements.legend: An ardent student of the Codex Astartes, this commander epitomises its tactical genius, and the wisdom gleaned from its teachings guides their measured strategic responses amidst the fiercest battle.
enhancements.description: CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, instead of selecting a Combat Doctrine to be active for your army, you can select the Tactical Doctrine. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active for the bearer’s unit only, even if you have already selected that Combat Doctrine to be active for your army this battle.

enhancements.name: Stoic Defender
enhancements.legend: This commander and their warriors hold their ground tenaciously against even overwhelming numbers.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability while they are within range of an objective marker you control and, while that unit is Battle-shocked, halve the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit instead of changing it to 0.

enhancements.name: Orb of the Emperor’s Aegis
enhancements.legend: What Dark Age technology may lie inside this icon-wreathed sphere pales compared to its true power: that of the Emperor’s blessing. When activated, the orb briefly emits a glowing nimbus of protective energy so powerful that it can hold back the corruptive fury of the naked Warp. Thus shielded, Black Templars may use their fleet’s teleportarium shrines even without the awesome protection of Terminator armour.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Blazing Icon
enhancements.legend: What was before merely a decorative blood drop pendant now shines with a seemingly miraculous light as bright as any star. The foe are forced to avert their gaze from its wrathful magnificence.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Umbral Raptor
enhancements.legend: This warrior is a solitary predator whose footsteps are all but silent and whose form is one with the shadows.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

enhancements.name: Merciless Denunciation
enhancements.legend: Through roared words or ruthless deeds, may the blasphemous be denounced and the worthy driven into a furious rage of sanctified slaughter.
enhancements.description: Chaplain or Judiciar model only. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Archangel’s Shard
enhancements.legend: When Sanguinius battled Horus, his magnificent blade was tragically shattered against the Warmasters profane battle plate. The shards were gathered up and new swords forged to incorporate them, each one gifted to a different successor Chapter.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [Anti-Chaos 5+] and [Lance] abilities.

enhancements.name: Forged in Battle
enhancements.legend: To this Angel of Death, war is the anvil upon which their strength is wrought. Every battle is seen as a test in which they and their battle-brothers can prove themselves, and the superior craftsmanship of their weapons and armour.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, once per turn, after making a Hit roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, you can change the result of that roll to an unmodified 6.

enhancements.name: Weapons of the First Legion
enhancements.legend: Beneath the surface of the Rock lie vaults within which weapons of antiquity and terrible power are stored.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer s melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Forged in Battle
enhancements.legend: To this Angel of Death, war is the anvil upon which their strength is wrought. Every battle is seen as a test in which they and their battle-brothers can prove themselves, and the superior craftsmanship of their weapons and armour.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, once per turn, after making a Hit roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, you can change the result of that roll to an unmodified 6.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.legend: A veteran inductee of the Inner Circle, this champion has served amongst the Deathwing for centuries and become an unmatched master of teleportarium insertions.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Icon of the Angel
enhancements.legend: The Icon of the Angel reminds the Blood Angels of the heretics who fled after laying low Sanguinius, exhorting them to let no enemy escape their grasp again.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit is selected to Fall Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

enhancements.name: Obfuscation
enhancements.legend: By manipulating the minds of the foe, practitioners of telepathy may obfuscate their presence.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Psyker model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit, and if the Telepathy Discipline is active for your army, the bearer’s unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

enhancements.name: Augury Servo-host
enhancements.legend: This warrior's auto-senses are linked to a circling host of servo-skulls crafted from the remains of favoured serfs and failed neophytes. Fitted with ocular probes and sensor vanes, they provide the Black Templar with advanced targeting information to pick out the unbelievers who cower in concealment.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

enhancements.name: Student of the Codex
enhancements.legend: This prodigal officer has focused upon one aspect of the Codex Astartes and means to master its every aspect before moving on to the next.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the start of your next Command phase, the Tactical Doctrine is active for this unit (instead of any other Combat Doctrine you select to be active for your army, and even if there is no Combat Doctrine active for your army).

enhancements.name: To Slay the Warmaster
enhancements.legend: Overcome by maddening hallucinations, this warrior sees in all enemy champions glimmers of Horus' dark majesty and thus strives to destroy them.
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy CHARACTER units, you can select one of those CHARACTER units and roll six D6: for each 4+, one CHARACTER model in that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Rites of War
enhancements.legend: The commanders of the 1st Company vow before the Chapter and the Emperor to secure victory.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

enhancements.name: Execute and Redeploy
enhancements.legend: The battle-brothers under this warrior’s command seize every opportunity to strike while the initiative is theirs, harrying the foe with gunfire before returning to the shadows.
enhancements.description: PHOBOS model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer’s unit has shot, if that unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge. This cannot allow the bearer’s unit to move more than once in your Shooting phase.

enhancements.name: Singular Will
enhancements.legend: This warrior lets nothing stand in their way or slow their advance, closing swiftly and relentlessly with their quarry
enhancements.description: Deathwing model only. Each time the bearer’s unit Piles In or Consolidates, models in that unit can move an additional 3".

enhancements.name: Fangrune Pendant
enhancements.legend: The fangs strung upon this adamantine thread belonged to the eldest and most cunning Fenrisian wolves. They are graven with runes of wisdom and guile, which are said to enhance the wearer’s own further.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Indomitable Champion
enhancements.legend: Even seemingly mortal wounds will not turn a son of Dorn from his duty.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Chariots of the Storm
enhancements.legend: This dedicated flight of gunships attends the Great Wolf and his packs, and can be called in to rapidly reposition his forces in the moments before battle is joined.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Orbital Uplink Reliquary
enhancements.legend: Though it appears a morbid trinket of faith, in truth this device contains a powerful microcogitator linked to the strategium of the orbiting strike cruiser, which helps the bearer coordinate rapid strategic redeployments.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Feinting Withdrawal
enhancements.legend: This living legend of the Chapter is known for their calm in the heat of battle. Ever-observant of the ebbs and flows of the engagement, they can withdraw their warriors from the fray in good order, ready to hammer home a torrent of fire.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Taramond’s Censer
enhancements.legend: Though the Black Templars are acclimatised to the acrid chemical incense burned within this iron thurible, their foes are not. Its fumes trigger nightmare visions and crippling terror amongst their ranks.
enhancements.description: Black Templars model only. At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit must take a Battle-shock test. When doing so, subtract 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.legend: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Deathwatch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Stalwart Champion
enhancements.legend: Possessed of obdurate will, this warrior champion instils an indomitable resolve and absolute refusal to cede ground within his brothers.
enhancements.description: Captain, Chaplain or Lieutenant model only. While the bearer’s unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Iron Laurel
enhancements.legend: A subcutaneous cranial honour relic, this device contains a strategic orbital upload relay.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

enhancements.name: Blades of Valour
enhancements.legend: This officer and their honour guard of dedicated battle-brothers have been presented with masterwork combat blades in recognition of the selfless battle they are about to fight.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer and Battleline models in the bearer’s unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Eye
enhancements.legend: This augmetic eye enhances the user’s visual spectrum, enabling them to pinpoint heat signatures and cogitate appropriate firing solutions.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

enhancements.name: Sanguinary Tear (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Legend has it that the blood-red stone set into this relic houses a teardrop shed by the Primarch himself. Those lost to the Black Rage seem to fight all the more furiously in its presence.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While a friendly Death Company unit is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Scroll of Proclamation
enhancements.legend: Finely scribed on vellum and tightly bound in an armoured scroll case, the words of Roboute Guilliman’s Consilias Imperitus Ultimar prove a constant source of inspiration that drive this warrior ever onward.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer’s unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Charge roll.

enhancements.name: Spy-skull Data Link
enhancements.legend: Several artificer-crafted and heavily shrouded servo-skulls are tethered to this device, their linked visual feeds making the bearer nigh impossible to evade.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Shock Deployment
enhancements.legend: From the ramps of armoured transports, elite infantry deploy swiftly, unleashing fire on overawed enemies.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator or Gravis model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

enhancements.name: Firestorm Coordinators
enhancements.legend: This vehicle’s fire control systems incorporate ancient yet highly advanced logic engines, which assist the crew in obtaining firing solutions and keeping up an exceptionally rapid rate of fire.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

enhancements.name: Adept of the Omnissiah
enhancements.legend: This battle-brother is steeped in hidden technological rites. Should their armoured charges be threatened, a burst of arcane binharic screed can rouse their machine spirits to vigilance.
enhancements.description: TECHMARINE model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Wolf Master
enhancements.legend: This warrior possesses an affinity with Fenrisian beasts and can inspire a frothing rage in their lupine companions with but a single barked command.
enhancements.description: Space Wolves model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly SPACE WOLVES unit within 9" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, teeth and claws and Tyrnak and Fenrir weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

enhancements.name: Hordeslayer
enhancements.legend: Seeking to take a terrible tally of lives, this warrior hurls himself into the heart of the fight, heedless of the numbers arrayed against him.
enhancements.description: Space Wolves model only. At the start of the Fight phase, if there are more enemy models than friendly models wholly within 6" of the bearer, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. If the bearer’s unit has achieved one or more Boasts, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic instead.

enhancements.name: Elder’s Guidance
enhancements.legend: Wily and long of fang, this warrior brings centuries of battlefield experience to the fight, lending focus to the reckless fury of his youthful battle-brothers.
enhancements.description: Space Wolves model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if the bearer is leading a Blood Claws unit, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Instincts
enhancements.legend: Those who master the Path of Ambush guide their forces to launch surprise assaults on the enemy with the precise timing of true hunters.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Movement phase, if the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Skjald’s Foretelling
enhancements.legend: Great deeds have been prophesied for this champion, such that those who fight alongside him do so all the harder as they play out the self-fulfilling prophecy.
enhancements.description: Wolf Guard Battle Leader model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.

enhancements.name: Liberatum
enhancements.legend: Forged on Macragge by the finest artisans, this weapon’s machine spirit is said to burn with a desire to see the Five Hundred Worlds ripped from the grasp of heretics and despots.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if the target is within range of an objective marker, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Vengeful Onslaught
enhancements.legend: This Son of Sanguinius appears to the brothers of the Death Company as a paragon of their Primarchs martial prowess. Should he fall in battle, the vengeful fury of the Lost will be inflamed.
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. It the bearer is destroyed, until the end of your next turn, each time a friendly DEATH COMPANY model makes an attack, add 1 to the 1 Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Ravenwing
enhancements.legend: This commander has mastered the art of cavalry combat, instinctively noticing the opportune position to strike and navigating the chaos of battle with preternatural precision.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Deathwing Assault
enhancements.legend: Employing shock assault doctrines requiring ancient technology and immense tactical skill, the Deathwing are masters of catching their foes wholly unawares.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Gleaming Pinions
enhancements.legend: The elaborately crafted ailerons of this jump pack allow the wearer to manoeuvre, twist and bank at incredible speeds.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. Once per turn, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of the bearer, if this bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Architect of War
enhancements.legend: There are few who have a deeper understanding of the tenets of siege warfare than this warrior.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Master of Machine War
enhancements.legend: This commander is supremely gifted in the strategies of armoured warfare, understanding the capabilities of every war engine in the Chapters arsenal. Delivering precision orders, they ensure the vehicles under their command inflict the most punishing damage to the enemy even amidst complex manoeuvres.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that VEHICLE is eligible to shoot even if it Fell Back or Advanced this turn.

enhancements.name: Armoured Commander
enhancements.legend: This veteran commander of mechanised infantry utilises its manoeuvrability to ensnare the foe.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that TRANSPORT on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.legend: This flowing cloak or finely wrought tabard is laced through with threads of braided adamantine. When combined with armour and energy fields, it has been shown time and again that these symbols of office are proof against even the very strongest attacks.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made with a Melta or Torrent weapon, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Iron Resolve
enhancements.legend: This hero shrugs off even horrendous wounds.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Once per battle, after the bearer’s unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Dedicated Gunship
enhancements.legend: Bulky and somewhat lumbering as they are, Terminator squads – or even particularly vital officers wearing Terminator plate – may be assigned a gunship for swift combat extraction and relocation mid-battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Ordained Sacrifice
enhancements.legend: Knowing only too well the desperate and vital nature of the battle before him, this scion of Sanguinius echoes his Primarch’s resolute determination to fight on even beyond what seems the doors of certain death.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: The Tome of Ectoclades
enhancements.legend: This grimoire, bound in the skin of the alien, holds the most powerful truths the Deathwatch have uncovered about their foes, whether xenos or those who harbour them. On occasion, such knowledge has been known to save not only the book’s custodian, but entire worlds.
enhancements.description:
Watch Master or Captain model only. Once per battle, after you have selected your Oath of Moment target, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select a second enemy unit to be an Oath of Moment target.

Designer’s Note: This means that each time a model with the Oath of Moment ability makes an attack that targets either of your Oath of Moment targets, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Shadow War Veteran
enhancements.legend: By the time the enemy believes battle has begun, their rear lines have already been attacked at this warriors command - their supply lines cut and their communications in disarray - choking them off from vital battlefield support.
enhancements.description:
PHOBOS model only. Gain following ability:
Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Bombast Omnivox
enhancements.legend: This remarkable technological relic is mounted within the bearer’s armour gorget and facilitates code-hardened, rapid-exchange intelligence dissemination while in battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer’s unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Zealous Vanguard
enhancements.legend: This warrior is an unstoppable crusader whose hearts burn like twin pyres of eager zeal. Ever at the forefront of combat, he leads his warriors as the tip of the crusades blade.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Fulgus Magna
enhancements.legend: This ancient teleport homer projects a powerful narrow‑band signal, enabling the teleportarium chambers of orbiting vessels to lock on to the bearer even amid severe atmospheric or empyric disturbances.
enhancements.description: Deathwing model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Herald of Sacred Slaughter
enhancements.legend: A pious harbinger of the crusade’s destructive potential, this warrior pushes forward at the first opportunity, eager to bring the Emperor’s judgement to the foe.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Dedicated Transport, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Steel Font
enhancements.legend: An advanced auto-chirurgeon claimed by legend to be  the product of Ferrus Manus’ own labours, this device rapidly reknits sundered flesh and armour alike.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, in your Command phase, you can return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model to that unit.

enhancements.name: Fusillade
enhancements.legend: The Librarian wreathes the ammunition of his allies in armour-eroding halos of azure fire.
enhancements.description:
Adeptus Astartes Psyker model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 5+] abilities, and:
  • The [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability if the Pyromancy Discipline is active for your army.
  • Add 6" to the Range characteristic of those weapons if the Telekinesis Discipline is active for your army.

enhancements.name: Recon Hunter
enhancements.legend: This commander is an expert scout as well as hunter, and takes advantage of these skills to seize the most advantageous position before battle begins.
enhancements.description: Ravenwing model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Chogorian Huntmaster
enhancements.legend: This mounted huntsman knows well the importance of manoeuvre, outflanking the enemy and ambushing unsuspecting foes from the flanks and rear, the better to land the killing blow.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED model only. If the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Instincts
enhancements.legend: This mounted huntsman espouses the value of circling the enemy and striking suddenly from an unexpected quarter upon their speeding steed, the better to land the killing blow.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED model only. If the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

enhancements.name: Fire Discipline
enhancements.legend: This commander drills his warriors relentlessly; combined with the Adeptus Astartes’ incredible reflexes, they produce a devastating rate of fire.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, you can reroll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Veteran of Behemoth
enhancements.legend: Having battled the Tyranid swarms since their first galactic invasion, this veteran officer knows well the benefit of efficient and overwhelming firepower.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Angel’s Fang
enhancements.legend: This artificer-crafted weapon has a dark reputation amongst the Chapter. Yet none can deny its lethality, or its machine-spirit’s desire to drink the blood of the mightiest foes.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

enhancements.name: Gift of Foresight
enhancements.legend: This heroic warrior bears a glimmering of Sanguinius' prophetic gifts. Flashes of foresight allow him to weave around his enemy's blows with supernatural skill.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle round, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for the bearer, you can treat the result as an unmodified roll of 6 instead.

enhancements.name: Pennant of Remembrance
enhancements.legend: This hallowed banner records the names and deeds of legendary members of the Deathwing, stoking still firmer resolve in those who fight beneath it.
enhancements.description: Ancient model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. While that unit is Battle-shocked, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

enhancements.name: Defensive Mastery
enhancements.legend: Few officers of the Chapter can match this commander’s talent for cunning defensive troop dispositions.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Helm of the Beastslayer
enhancements.legend: Wrought from the carapace of a nameless xenos monstrosity, this helm offers unparalleled protection.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time an attack made by a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE model targets the bearer’s unit, reduce the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Thunderwolf’s Fortitude
enhancements.legend: Possessed of indomitable fortitude, this champion of Fenris refuses the call of Morkai, fighting beyond the limits of even a Space Marine’s endurance.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, remove it from play, then, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Astartes Tank Ace (Aura)
enhancements.legend: The commander of this battle tank is a storied tank ace whose exploits are the stuff of Chapter legend. Crews who fight at their side are inspired by their aggression and eagerness to join the battle.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model only. In your Shooting phase, while a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE unit is within 6" of the bearer, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Feral Rage
enhancements.legend: There is no substitute for raw aggression. This warrior fights with the berserk rage of a thunderwolf, tearing apart their foes with violent fury.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add an additional 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons.

enhancements.name: Warden of Honour
enhancements.legend: This lauded guardian is trusted with the stewardship of the crusade’s most precious standards. His unyielding presence and preservation of his charge amidst fire and heresy inspire his brothers to acts of extreme heroism.
enhancements.description: Crusade Ancient model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time you roll one D6 for the bearer’s Vengeful Exhortation ability, add 1 to the result.

enhancements.name: Longstrider
enhancements.legend: This champion is renowned amongst their battle-brothers for their relentless pace when on the hunt, their loping strides eating up the miles as they run the foe to ground.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Benediction of Fury
enhancements.legend: Borne through a dozen bloody and hard-fought crusades, this crozius arcanum’s unique empathokinetic circuitry has absorbed the bellicosity and righteous wrath of every Chaplain who has ever wielded it. As a result, it now strikes with the force of a thunderbolt.
enhancements.description: Chaplain model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

enhancements.name: Malodraxian Standard
enhancements.legend: Crafted in the aftermath of Lysander’s great victory over the Iron Warriors on Malodrax, this gilded banner inspires the Imperial Fists to shatter their foes.
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Ancient model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.legend: This flowing cloak or finely wrought tabard is laced through with threads of braided adamantine. When combined with armour and energy fields, it has been shown time and again that these symbols of office are proof against even the very strongest attacks.
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made with a Melta or Torrent weapon, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Borthrod Gland
enhancements.legend: The Kroot found the flesh of the Borthrod so irresistible they hunted them to extinction. This preserved gland still exudes pheromones that drive nearby Kroot into a ravenous frenzy.
enhancements.description: Kroot Flesh Shaper only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Supernova Launcher
enhancements.legend: Adapted from standard-issue fragmentation projectors, this weapon enables the bearer to fire explosive plasma charges on parabolic trajectories. These projectiles drop amongst the enemy and explode in a coruscating fireball that evaporates metal and flesh alike.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one airbursting fragmentation projector equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 3, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Internal Grenade Racks
enhancements.legend: These thigh plates house deployment rails of high-explosive bomblets. As the pilot jets over the foe, the racks can be triggered to dispense a rain of death.
enhancements.description: T’au Empire Battlesuit model only. The bearer has the Grenades keyword, and each time the bearer ends a Normal move, you can select one enemy unit that it moved over during that move. If you do, roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Experienced Leader
enhancements.legend: This Shaper has defeated - and quite possibly devoured - such foes before. They are well able to advise their warriors on how to fight them.
enhancements.description: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the end of the battle, each time a KROOT model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Student of Kauyon
enhancements.legend: This Shaper has not only studied the Code of Fire but has also adapted it to best suit their people’s skills.
enhancements.description: Kroot Shaper model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three Kroot Carnivores or Kroot Farstalkers units from your army. Models in those units have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Coordinated Exploitation
enhancements.legend: This leader eschews their own martial glory in favour of seeking out an advanced vantage point then exploiting it to guide in the firepower of their fellows.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

enhancements.name: Target Optimisation Microdrones
enhancements.legend: A swarm of tiny experimental drones swarm about this warrior, analysing weaknesses in enemy wargear.
enhancements.description: CADRE FiREbLADE model only. Once per turn, in your Shooting phase, when a friendly FiRE WARRiOR, PATHFiNDER TEAM or CADRE FIREBLADE unit within 6" of the bearer is selected to shoot, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon
enhancements.legend: Long meditation upon the tenets of the Patient Hunter has seen this warrior master the application of this cunning ambush strategy. When they take to the battlefield, they embody the teachings of the Kauyon, much to the dismay of their luckless prey.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter Detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round onwards instead of from the third.

enhancements.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
enhancements.legend: The thermoneutronic projector uses volatile gases siphoned from the coronae of neutron stars to expel a flame capable of searing through the armour plating of a battle tank.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one T’au flamer equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Admired Leader
enhancements.legend: Having proven themselves to their alien charges, this T’au has won their fierce loyalty and become an iconic folk hero to them.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model (excluding Kroot models) only. In your Command phase, you can select one KROOT or Vespid Stingwings unit within 12" of the bearer. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, improve the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1, and while such a unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Quill Marker
enhancements.legend: Subtly adapted through careful shaping, this warrior can use their pheromone dart-quills to mark prey that their raiding party then descend upon with predatory fury.
enhancements.description: At the start of your Charge phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the end of the phase, each time a KROOT unit from your army declares a charge, if it is within 6" of that enemy unit, it can include that enemy unit as a target of that charge, even if it is not visible to it.

enhancements.name: Precision of the Patient Hunter
enhancements.legend: This warrior prowls the battlefield like a high-tech predator, stalking and assessing their quarry before they strike. When they do launch their assault, their every shot and blow is informed by careful observations, perfectly aimed where they will do the greatest harm.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. From the third battle round onwards, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

enhancements.name: Prototype Weapon System
enhancements.legend: Famed battlesuit pilots are often more than willing to assist Earth caste scientists infield-testing the latest in experimental weapons technology.
enhancements.description: T’au Empire Battlesuit model only. Each time the bearer is selected to shoot, select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until those attacks are resolved, ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the selected ability.

enhancements.name: Duty’s Echo
enhancements.legend: This tech-inlaid stave glows with the light of the T’au’va, inspiring nearby warriors to greater efforts.
enhancements.description: ETHEREAL model only. At the end of your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly FiRE WARRiOR or PATHFiNDER TEAM unit within 6" of the bearer. If you do, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 3" and then counts as having performed the Set Overwatch Tactical Manoeuvre this turn.

enhancements.name: Exemplar of the Mont’ka
enhancements.legend: This warrior has perfected the art of the Killing Blow, formulating swift and decisive battle plans and leading their cadres from the front in aggressive strikes.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow Detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well.

enhancements.name: Kroothawk Flock
enhancements.legend: This leader has painstakingly established a deep-seated bond with a small flock of Kroothawks. The avian creatures circle on high, spying out and revealing the hiding places of the prey or warning of ambushing enemies with wing-dips, diving stoops and harsh shrieks.
enhancements.description: Kroot model only. Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enhancements.legend: The plasma accelerator rifle blends pulse-induction technology with a high-yield plasma generator, rendering it highly effective against both infantry and light vehicles.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one plasma rifle equipped by the bearer. Improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 2, and improve the Attacks, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of that weapon by 1.

enhancements.name: Fanatical Convert
enhancements.legend: This true believer strives to embody the T’au’va even more entirely than the T’au themselves.
enhancements.description: Kroot model only. The bearer’s unit has the For the Greater Good ability.

enhancements.name: Nomadic Hunter
enhancements.legend: This Shaper’s followers have become adept at the loping pursuit, snapping off harassing fire as they tirelessly and mercilessly run their victims to ground.
enhancements.description: Kroot Trail Shaper model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, add 3" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

enhancements.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
enhancements.legend: Commander Puretide was the most gifted T’au war leader of all time. Upon his death, his memories were stored in a neurochip. When implanted into the brain, the bearer can access much of this wisdom.
enhancements.description: T’au Empire Battlesuit model only. Each time you target the bearer’s unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Strategic Conqueror
enhancements.legend: A wise commander appreciates the strategic value of seizing a vital battlefield asset swiftly to establish a foothold, employing it as a jumping off point for further assaults or a rallying post for a swift retreat.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. At the start of the first battle round, before the first turn begins, select one objective marker on the battlefield. While a friendly T’AU EMPIRE model is within range of that objective marker and the bearer is on the battlefield, add 1 to that friendly model’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Solid-image Projection Unit
enhancements.legend: This holowave-emitter drone projects beams of so-called heavy light, forming convincing illusory images while simultaneously masking the true locations of its allies with advanced refraction fields.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three T’AU EMPIRE units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Starflare Ignition System
enhancements.legend: The ignition thrusters on selected battlesuits are augmented with optional feed-selectors, allowing the pilot to release a jet of enriched accelerant upon take-off and sending the pilots streaking skywards.
enhancements.description: T’au Empire Battlesuit model only. At the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Through Unity, Devastation
enhancements.legend: Under their calm tutelage of this leader, warriors of the Fire caste maximise every shot they fire, creating a blizzard of deadly energy.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only (excluding Kroot Shaper models). While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer unit, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in a Guided unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability while targeting their Spotted unit.

enhancements.name: Strike Swiftly
enhancements.legend: This commander knows victory is best assured by taking the fight to the enemy as soon as battle is joined.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. At the start of the battle, before any moves are made using the Scouts ability, you can select up to two friendly T’AU EMPIRE units within 6" of the bearer that do not have the Scouts ability. Until the end of the battle, all models in the selected units have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Fusion Blades
enhancements.legend: Fusion blades resemble modified versions of the T’au fusion blaster. However, when fired, each weapon unleashes a continuous beam of volatile energy that extends from the muzzle of the weapon.
enhancements.description: T’AU EMPIRE model only. Select one fusion blaster equipped by the bearer. Improve the Attacks characteristic of that weapon by 1, improve the Strength characteristic of that weapon by 3, and that weapon has the [MELTA 4] ability.

enhancements.name: Root-carved Weapons
enhancements.legend: Just as the Kroot venerate the so-called Roots from which their culture derives, so they prize the traditional forms of Root-carved weapons and must perform exceptional deeds to be permitted to wield them in war.
enhancements.description: Kroot War Shaper model only. All weapons equipped by the bearer have the [PRECISION] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

enhancements.name: Transponder Lock Module
enhancements.legend: This system detects transponders borne deep into the field by alien auxiliaries and guides its user unerringly in on their positions.
enhancements.description: T’au Empire Walker model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules. During your first Movement phase, when you set up the bearer’s unit, it must be set up within 12" of one or more friendly Kroot or Vespid Stingwings units and not within 9" horizontally of one or more enemy units.

enhancements.name: Risen Rubricae
enhancements.legend: A plan decades in the making comes to fruition as hidden, silent Rubricae emerge at a fateful hour to deliver the killing blow.
enhancements.description: THOUSAND SONS model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select either two Rubricae Battleline units from your army or one other Rubricae unit from your army; models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Nethershriek Mind-eater
enhancements.legend: This occultist draws upon an eldritch contract with a daemonic gheist. The entity gleefully tears into weak wills, feasts on doubts and screams its burning laughter into the recesses of its prey’s meagre souls.
enhancements.description: THOUSAND SONS or Lord of Change model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Warpmeld Dagger
enhancements.legend: Sacrifice is ever at the route of infernal power, even better when bought with the grossest of betrayal.
enhancements.description: Tzaangor Shaman model only. Each time the bearer attempts a Ritual, just before determining the Psychic test result, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds; if it is not destroyed as a result, add 1 to that Psychic test result for each of those mortal wounds suffered.

enhancements.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
enhancements.legend: This Sorcerer has committed many a grimoire and unholy tome to memory, giving them unparalleled knowledge of hexes, curses and destructive rites.
enhancements.description: THOUSAND SONS model only. Each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving that Ritual, add 6" to its range.

enhancements.name: Arcane Might
enhancements.legend: Drawing upon the rampant Warp energies coursing across the battlefield, this sorcerous champion imbues their weapons and those of their talented underlings with soul-shattering force.
enhancements.description: THOUSAND SONS model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in that unit instead.

enhancements.name: Thrallmaster
enhancements.legend: In the eyes of this Sorcerer, thronging masses of cultists and Tzaangors are little more than cannon fodder to be used as living shield.
enhancements.description: At the start of the first battle round, you can select one friendly THOUSAND SONS CULTiSTS or TzAANGORS unit within the same Entry Zone as the bearer. If you do, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Warp Mastery
enhancements.legend: This psyker is steeped in the malefic secrets of the warp. Their powers are manifested with a terrifying and destructive intensity.
enhancements.description: Each time you roll to determine the number of attacks made with a Psychic weapon equipped by the bearer, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Warp Syphon
enhancements.legend: This Sorcerer greedily digs into the occult ley lines that thread a cabal’s war engines, redirecting unwelcome surges of empyric overflow into the vehicles’ structure.
enhancements.description: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly Thousand Sons Vehicle units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, after you roll that additional D6 but before checking for doubles or triples, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one of those VEHICLE units; that VEHICLE unit suffers 1 mortal wound and you can re-roll that additional D6.

enhancements.name: Predestined Champion
enhancements.legend: Many strands of fate intertwine about this Champion of Tzeentch, for it has been foretold that he may achieve greatness. Of course, fate is ever fickle...
enhancements.description: While the bearer is on the battlefield, you are considered to control one additional objective marker for the purposes of the Twisting Fate army rule.

enhancements.name: Prescient Authority
enhancements.legend: This Sorcerer exerts their domineering will over their mortal charges and guides their hands as they lash out at the enemy with beak, blade and talon.
enhancements.description: Once per turn, when a friendly THOUSAND SONS CULTiSTS or TzAANGORS unit within 3" of the bearer is selected to shoot or fight, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that THOUSAND SONS CULTISTS or TZAANGORS unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Diabolic Savant
enhancements.legend: By making a promise of blood and souls, this Sorcerer draws an infernal sentience near. It presses against the straining veil of reality, and from its fanged maw spill gibbered secrets of sanity-straining sorcery.
enhancements.description: Thousand Sons Infantry model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly Scintillating Legions units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

enhancements.name: Empowered Manifestation
enhancements.legend: The many eyes of this witch lord blaze with barely contained arcane might. Whilst the spells they unleash are rendered far more lethal, such destructive power comes at significant risk.
enhancements.description: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, you can add 6" to the range of Psychic abilities the bearer has that specify a range (including Rituals) and each time a model in the bearer’s unit takes a Hazardous test for a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the result.

enhancements.name: Fires of Change
enhancements.legend: Those struck by this psyker’s sorcery are engulfed in vibrant, flickering flames that inflict horrifying mutations upon their bodies.
enhancements.description: Each time the bearer shoots, after it has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a Psychic weapon. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Diamond of Distortion
enhancements.legend: This precious gem is infused with a strange energy that distorts reality around the bearer, making them all but impossible to strike.
enhancements.description: Tzaangor Shaman model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Incandaeum
